scope: 48 local corrected-reader trials; evidence aggregation only, no new measurements, remote performance or layout selection

policy.first: fresh native uv process; opening + discovery + fetch + separate decoding where geometry returned; process/import startup excluded
policy.reuse: same reader instance; metadata retained; source validation between repeats may warm local files; not a cold repeat
policy.buffers: 0 and65536 read-ahead bytes are controlled trial settings, not selected production constants; Parquet grouped/pre_buffer true uses Arrow default lazy cache behavior
policy.transport: local serialized returned bytes/calls, not physical disk traffic or HTTP/CDN behavior; HTTP counters are zero
policy.phases: transport counters are deltas per phase; cumulative includes opening once; materialized values count decoded projected feature/graph batches, excluding lookup batches; selected logical bytes are output Arrow nbytes
policy.geometry: record_probe unconditionally decodes geometry with shapely.from_wkb when present, reports decoding separately, and includes it in total
policy.memory: serialized per-file read-ahead capacity is not all retained memory or a process cap; Arrow allocation snapshots, column-chunk prebuffer, tables, query arrays and independent source validation are separate; lifetime peak RSS includes validation
policy.os: filesystem/OS cache uncontrolled, no cold-disk claim; trial run order not randomized; no statistical confidence intervals
policy.overlap: four affected commands retain exact recorded timing in trials but have elapsed_claim_eligible=false; comparison elapsed fields null; no elapsed layout claim allowed for them
policy.fidelity: all selected-result semantic and exact Arrow-stream source checks pass; these do not replace full artifact identity and global verification witnesses
